title: 第三章残墟生异兆稚子踏征途第四章途逢真仙授天篆悟玄机

洪水退去，清溪古镇却久久未能抚平天灾留下的疮痍。
骄阳悬于天际，驱散了连日阴雨的湿冷，却晒不透街巷间弥漫的泥泞与悲凉。断壁残垣错落而立，被洪水冲垮的屋舍只剩半截木架，倒伏的良田满目狼藉，浑浊的淤泥铺满每一寸土地，空气中混杂着泥土腥气与草木腐朽的味道，再无往日江南古镇的温婉安宁。
劫后余生的百姓，未曾沉溺于侥幸，纷纷扛起农具、拎起箩筐，在废墟之上开启重建。男人们扛木修屋、疏浚河道、加固堤坝，女人们洗衣做饭、照料伤者、清理淤泥，孩童们也跟着捡拾碎瓦、搬运杂物，古镇上下，皆是忙碌奔走的身影，唯有低声的叹息，藏着对家园被毁的心酸，对逝去亲人的思念。
何家小院虽地势稍高，未被彻底冲毁，却也积了厚厚一层淤泥，门窗歪斜，院落狼藉。何老实与林氏天不亮便起身，忙着清理淤泥、修缮屋舍，何年、何月、何日三兄妹，亦紧随父母身后，力所能及地搭手帮忙。
何年虽身形瘦小，却心思沉稳，他不似寻常孩童只顾埋头劳作，而是一边清理院落，一边目光沉沉地望着四周。灾后的清溪河，虽恢复了几分平缓，河水却依旧浑浊，河畔堤坝虽经乡邻抢修，却依旧布满裂痕，脆弱不堪。
他心中清楚，此番洪水平息，不过是三人临时觉醒一丝神祇本源，暂压天地戾气，并非时序紊乱之象彻底化解。三界历法依旧破碎，时序玉璧裂痕未补，阴阳失衡的根源未曾根除，这场洪灾，终究只是凡尘历劫的第一劫，往后，必有更凶险的劫难接踵而至。
闲暇之时，何年常独自立于清溪河畔，指尖轻轻拂过河畔的青石，闭眼感受着天地间的气息。空气中依旧弥漫着紊乱的时序之气，阴阳交错，四时失序，那股潜藏的危机感，始终萦绕在他心头，挥之不去。
脑海中，破碎的记忆愈发清晰，时序神域的金碧辉煌、玉帝肃穆的面容、时序玉璧上触目惊心的裂痕、三界生灵受苦的幻象，不断交织浮现，心底那份救世的使命，愈发沉重。
“兄长，你又在想心事？”
轻柔的声音从身后传来，何月缓步走到他身侧，手中捧着一束刚采摘的野花，眉眼间依旧带着几分灾后的愁绪，却难掩天生的柔善温婉。
这些时日，她跟着母亲照料受伤的乡邻，给流离失所的孩童送去吃食，用柔和的话语安抚人心，周身月华之气虽依旧被封印，却在一次次悲悯众生之际，悄然变得愈发浓郁，偶尔周身会泛起淡淡的柔光，让伤者心绪安宁，让枯萎的草木生出几分绿意。
何日也紧随其后走来，他天生力气大，这些天帮着乡邻搬运重物、修缮房屋，从不叫苦喊累，古铜色的脸颊上沾着些许泥渍，眼神却愈发刚毅。见何年面色凝重，他当即开口，语气铿锵：“兄长，是不是又有灾祸要来了？若是有妖邪作祟，我定冲在前头，护着乡邻，护着爹娘和姐姐！”
何年睁开眼，看向身旁弟弟妹妹，眼底闪过一丝动容，随即又恢复沉稳，轻声道：“天地时序未复，灾祸不会就此停歇。我们能平息一次洪水，却挡不住源源不断的劫难，这清溪古镇，终究不是长久安稳之地，我们的宿命，本就不在这方寸古镇之中。”
自洪水一役，三人本源之力相互感应，心意早已相通，无需多言，便懂彼此心中所想。何月与何日闻言，皆是点头，他们心中，同样有着莫名的牵引，仿佛有一个声音，无时无刻不在呼唤他们，离开故土，踏上征途，去寻找修补时序历法的方法，去化解三界苍生的浩劫。
就在三人沉默之际，古镇之中，忽然传来阵阵惊呼，一股诡异的气息，骤然弥漫开来。
原本晴空万里的苍穹，竟再次暗沉下来，不同于此前暴雨将至的乌云密布，而是透着一股阴森的灰雾，雾气翻涌，带着刺骨的寒意，瞬间笼罩整个古镇。
田间刚刚复苏的禾苗，以肉眼可见的速度枯萎发黄；院中抽芽的草木，瞬间枝叶凋零；就连街头嬉戏的孩童，都莫名浑身发冷，面色发白，哭闹不止。
更诡异的是，古镇残墟之中，那些被洪水冲毁的木梁、碎瓦，竟在灰雾之中微微颤动，隐隐有黑气缠绕，散发出暴戾的气息，周遭的时序之气，变得愈发混乱，岁月流转之力在此刻彻底失衡，仿佛有一股邪异力量，在肆意扭曲时光，摧残生灵。
“是时序紊乱引来的戾气邪祟！”

何年脸色骤变，当即握紧双拳。他能清晰感受到，那灰雾之中，蕴含着浓郁的时序戾气，乃是天地阴阳失衡、时序错乱太久，滋生而出的邪异之气，依附于废墟残骸之上，欲要祸害生灵，加剧苍生浩劫。
乡邻们被这突如其来的异状吓得惊慌失措，纷纷停下手中活计，惶恐地望着漫天灰雾，不知该如何是好。何老实与林氏急忙跑到三兄妹身边，将他们护在身后，满脸警惕地望着眼前诡异景象。
“爹娘，此地危险，我们快带乡邻们远离灰雾！”何年急声说道，此刻的他，虽依旧是孩童身躯，却有着远超常人的镇定与魄力。
他深知，这戾气邪祟，远比洪水更加凶险，若是任由其扩散，整个清溪古镇的百姓，都将被戾气侵蚀，轻则重病缠身，重则性命不保。
何月看着乡邻们惶恐的面容，看着草木枯萎、生机尽失的古镇，心中悲悯再起，周身月华之气不受控制地涌动，柔和的光芒缓缓扩散，试图抵挡灰雾戾气。可此次戾气太过浓郁，仅凭她一丝觉醒的月神之力，不过是杯水车薪，灰雾依旧在不断逼近。

The floods have receded, but Qingxi Ancient Town has been unable to heal the devastation left by the natural disaster for a long time.
The scorching sun hung in the sky, dispelling the dampness and coldness of the continuous rain, but it could not penetrate the mud and desolation that filled the streets. Broken walls and ruins stand scattered here and there. Only half of the wooden frames of the houses that were washed away by the flood are left. The fallen fertile fields are in a mess. Every inch of the land is covered with muddy mud. The air is mixed with the smell of earth and decaying vegetation. There is no longer the gentle and peaceful atmosphere of the ancient Jiangnan town in the past.
The people who survived the disaster did not indulge in luck. They picked up farm tools and baskets one after another and started rebuilding on the ruins. Men carried wood to build houses, dredged rivers, and strengthened dams. Women washed and cooked, took care of the injured, and cleaned up mud. Children also picked up broken tiles and carried debris. There were busy figures running up and down the ancient town. Only low sighs concealed the sadness of the destruction of their homes and the longing for their deceased relatives.
Although the He family's courtyard is located on a slightly higher ground and has not been completely washed away, a thick layer of silt has accumulated, the doors and windows are crooked, and the courtyard is in a mess. He Laoshi and Mrs. Lin got up before dawn and were busy cleaning up the mud and repairing the house. The three brothers and sisters, He year, He month and He day, also followed behind their parents and helped out as much as they could.
Although He Nian is small in stature, he has a calm mind. He is not like ordinary children who just immerse themselves in their work. Instead, he looks around with a heavy gaze while cleaning the courtyard. After the disaster, although the Qingxi River has regained some stability, the water is still turbid. Although the riverside dams have been repaired by neighbors, they are still full of cracks and fragile.
He knew in his heart that the subsidence of the flood was just a temporary awakening of a trace of the origin of the gods by the three of them, temporarily suppressing the hostility of the world, but not a complete resolution of the chaos in the time sequence. The calendar of the three realms is still broken, the cracks in the time sequence jade have not been repaired, and the root of the imbalance of yin and yang has not been eradicated. After all, this flood is only the first disaster in the mortal world. In the future, more dangerous disasters will surely follow.
In his spare time, He Nian often stands alone by the Qingxi River, his fingertips gently brushing the bluestones by the river, and he closes his eyes and feels the breath of heaven and earth. The air was still filled with the chaotic atmosphere of time, the yin and yang were intertwined, and the four seasons were out of order. The hidden sense of crisis always lingered in his heart and could not go away.
In my mind, the broken memories became clearer and clearer. The splendor of the Time God Realm, the solemn face of the Jade Emperor, the shocking cracks on the Time Jade, and the illusion of suffering in the three realms were constantly intertwined and emerging. The mission of saving the world in my heart became heavier and heavier.
"Brother, are you thinking about something again?"
A soft voice came from behind. He Yue walked slowly to his side, holding a bouquet of freshly picked wild flowers in her hands. There was still a bit of post-disaster melancholy in her eyebrows, but she could not hide her natural kindness and gentleness.
During these days, she followed her mother to take care of the injured neighbors, brought food to the displaced children, and soothed people's hearts with soft words. Although the moonlight energy around her was still sealed, it quietly became stronger and stronger as she felt compassion for all living beings. Occasionally, a faint soft light would appear around her, bringing peace to the injured and giving some greenness to the withered vegetation.
He Ri also followed closely behind. He was born with great strength. He had been helping his neighbors carry heavy objects and repair their houses these days. He never complained about being tired. There were some mud stains on his bronze cheeks, but his eyes became more resolute. Seeing He Nian's serious expression, he immediately spoke with a sonorous tone: "Brother, is there another disaster coming? If there is an evil spirit causing trouble, I will rush to the front to protect my neighbors, my parents and my sister!"
He Nian opened his eyes and looked at his brothers and sisters beside him. There was a flash of emotion in his eyes, and then he regained his composure and said softly: "The order of heaven and earth has not been restored, and the disasters will not stop here. We can calm down a flood, but we cannot stop the continuous disasters. After all, this Qingxi Ancient Town is not a stable place for a long time. Our destiny is not in this Fangcun Ancient Town."
Since the battle of the flood, the three people's original powers have been interacting with each other, and their minds have long been connected.No words are needed to understand what each other is thinking. He Yue and He Ri both nodded when they heard the words. They also had an inexplicable pull in their hearts, as if there was a voice calling them all the time to leave their homeland and embark on a journey to find a way to repair the time sequence calendar and resolve the catastrophe for the people in the three realms.
Just as the three of them were silent, bursts of exclamations suddenly came from the ancient town, and a strange aura suddenly filled the air.
The sky, which was originally clear and clear, turned dark again. It was different from the dark clouds that were approaching during the rainstorm before. Instead, there was a gloomy gray mist. The mist surged and brought a biting chill, instantly covering the entire ancient town.
The newly resurrected seedlings in the fields withered and turned yellow at a speed visible to the naked eye; the budding grass and trees in the courtyard instantly withered their branches and leaves; even the children playing on the street were inexplicably cold, their faces turned pale, and they cried incessantly.
What's even more strange is that among the ruins of the ancient town, the wooden beams and broken tiles that were washed away by the flood were trembling slightly in the gray mist, faintly entangled with black air, exuding a violent aura. The surrounding air of time became more and more chaotic, and the power of the passage of time was completely unbalanced at this moment, as if there was an evil force that was distorting time and destroying living creatures.
"It's the evil spirit caused by the disorder of time sequence!"
He Nian's expression suddenly changed and he immediately clenched his fists. He could clearly feel that the gray mist contained a strong evil energy of time. It was the evil energy that was bred from the imbalance of yin and yang in the heaven and earth and the time order that had been out of order for too long. It was attached to the ruins and wreckage, intending to harm living beings and aggravate the catastrophe of the common people.
The neighbors were frightened by this sudden abnormality. They stopped what they were doing and looked at the gray fog in the sky with fear, not knowing what to do. He Laoshi and Lin hurriedly ran to the three brothers and sisters, guarding them behind them, looking at the strange scene in front of them with vigilance.
"Mom and Dad, this place is dangerous. Let's take the neighbors away from the gray fog!" He Nian said urgently. At this moment, although he is still in the body of a child, he has the calmness and courage far beyond ordinary people.
He knew very well that this evil spirit was far more dangerous than floods. If it was allowed to spread, the people in the entire Qingxi Ancient Town would be eroded by the evil spirit, and they would be seriously ill at worst, or their lives would be at risk.
He Yue looked at the frightened faces of her neighbors and the ancient town with withered vegetation and loss of vitality. She felt compassion in her heart again. The moonlight energy around her body surged uncontrollably, and the soft light spread slowly, trying to resist the vicious energy of the gray fog. But this time the hostility was too strong, and her awakened power of the Moon God was just a drop in the bucket, as the gray fog continued to approach.
